verdict.rationale: Yapily offers some unattended, background-running operations. Its Payments API supports scheduled and periodic payments, and variable recurring payments can be collected without re-authorisation each time. Webhooks push real-time event notifications that a developer's own server can act on. However, these are payment primitives, not a user-configurable automation or agent layer, so any real automation logic must be built and hosted by the developer. Missing for 10: a native automation/workflow builder, agent-driven triggers or scheduled jobs beyond payments, autonomous background agent execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
